title: Fourteen Autumns and One Short Chart
subtitle: 社会发展 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社会发展（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）
meta: 主题语境：社会发展（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）　|　核心词汇：dynamic　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dynamic 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 my teacher ① studied a dynamic that no colleague in the office would have named, and he said the studying was the whole of the autumn. The ② dynamic, meaning the pattern and not the energy, ran fourteen autumns and stayed unnamed in the book; a dynamic, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ dynamic in that office had the same short chart at the end of it, and the ④ dynamic at the end, meaning the one they kept for the city and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A dynamic, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to study; my teacher said the studying is the part that fills fourteen autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the dynamic was the whole of the story, meaning the energy and not the pattern. The ⑥ dynamic, meaning the energy and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody relies on and nobody names; dynamic, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both a pattern and an energy. He said the energy is the part they remember.

By 2001 the ⑦ dynamic had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short chart. The ⑧ dynamic of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in October, was one office and fourteen autumns of studying; dynamic, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to study. She said the studying was never mentioned.

The ⑨ dynamic I remember is the one named in the file, which changed in 2013 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ dynamic, my mother said in 2015, is the only one that improves by being studied; every dynamic, she said, is an energy that has agreed to look like a pattern. She said the energy was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 动态；互动关系（指那间办公室里研究过的那一组）
B. n. 动态；互动关系（指那种动态本身，与活力相对）
C. 固定搭配：study a dynamic 研究一种动态
D. n. 动态；互动关系（指留给城市用的那一组）
E. n. 动态；互动关系（抽象总称，指一个团队的研究之事）
F. n. 动态；互动关系（指档案上写到、被列名的那一组）
G. n. 活力；动力（指故事里人人都依赖却无人说出的那样东西）
H. n. 活力；动力（抽象总称，指人人都依赖却无人说出的那种力量）

items.q: studied a dynamic that no colleague in the office would have named
The dynamic, meaning the pattern and not the energy

answers.why: study a dynamic 意为“研究一种动态”，1992 年老师研究了一种办公室里没有一位同事肯说出口的动态。
dynamic 意为“动态、互动关系”，指那种动态本身而不是活力，它经过了十四个秋天而在簿子上没有名字。
dynamic 意为“动态、互动关系”，指那间办公室里的每一种动态，每一种到头都有同一张短短的图表。
dynamic 意为“动态、互动关系”，指留给城市用的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
dynamic 意为“活力、动力”，指故事里人人都依赖却无人说出的那样东西，叔叔说这股动力就是那个故事的全部。
dynamic 意为“活力、动力”，指人人都依赖却无人说出的那种力量而不是那种动态，是故事里人人都依赖、却无人说出的东西。
dynamic 意为“动态、互动关系”，指档案上写到、被列名的那一组，到 2001 年这一组动态成了档案里的一行。
dynamic 意为“动态、互动关系”，老师十月写道，整件事的研究之事是一间办公室和十四个秋天的研究。
dynamic 意为“动态、互动关系”，我记得的是档案上列名的那一组，2013 年变了，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一组。
dynamic 为抽象总称，母亲 2015 年说，一种动态是唯一会因为被好好研究而变得更好的东西。
